`ordered-usb-pair.board.tsx` is a footprint-based variant of [core #5415](https://github.com/tscircuit/core/pull/5415), `tests/utils/autorouting/differential-pair-ordered-path-routing.test.tsx` at fcc86d0ddd72f587ea16d41ea89c6adbf7d7026f. It is archival capture source; this standalone matcher does not depend on core.

Core rendered USB Micro-B, SOT23-6 ESD, QFP16 MCU, and native SMT test-point footprints. An `autorouter.algorithmFn` recorded the unmodified SRJ in `ordered-usb-pair.srj.json`. `ordered-usb-pair.artwork.json` contains only native core silkscreen. `ordered-usb-pair.matcher.json` is the actual LengthMatchingSolver constructor input captured from a complete Pipeline 7 run on autorouter #3710 at 8508b7c126a751bfd2ec107abc84c23eea6885d4 (Bun 1.4.3), including HD routes, point-pair connections, differential pairs, and obstacles.

The fixture adapter only aliases generated names to P_AB/P_BC/N_AB/N_BC/tap and shuffles route order to retain the original exact membership assertions. All captured coordinates, widths, vias, bounds and obstacles are preserved. PCB elements are converted directly to SVG by circuit-to-svg; no custom drawing or labels are added. SRJ obstacle envelopes are rendered as SMT pads, including the connector shell obstacles.
